zoe_peopleops: Quick check before I lock the review flow — two tiny items: confirm the 48h grace policy and whether async votes are okay for managers who9re half-day OOO. Reply with a one-liner. :wave:

linda_hr: 48h grace OK for documented launch conflicts; after that managers must sign off and HR flags the record. Async votes on the sheet are fine (vote + 1-line reason).

eng-manager-arya: Confirm async vote on sheet works. Also: can managers upload comments incrementally as drafts? Some of us prefer iterative edits.

calib-lead-omar: Yes - incremental uploads allowed, but please mark "DRAFT" in the file name until final. Final upload deadline: 2026-04-13 12:00 PDT. Calibration meeting slots: Mon/Tue/Wed next week; leads will post invites.

peopleops-bot: Heads-up: managers on the early-review list have manager comment drafts due in 72h. Check calendar invite.

zoe_peopleops: Thanks. I'll publish the short checklist + form links tomorrow AM in #announcements. Managers: please forward the 3-line guidance to your teams: top outcomes, 1-2 artifacts, one growth goal (~200 words).

eng-manager-arya: Forwarding now. Ping me if anyone needs >48h extension and I9ll escalate.

linda_hr: Upload links for reference: forms: https://redwoodcompany.share/reviews/q2-2026-form, sheet: https://redwoodcompany.share/sheets/calibration-q2, uploads: /Shared/Reviews/2026-Q2

zoe_peopleops: Great, closing this thread. :white_check_mark:
